intentEvidence: Obsidian lets you pin a tab, but pinning doesn't stop the Close current tab command (Cmd+W / Ctrl+W by default) from closing it
problem: Pinned tabs can be accidentally closed by a single stray keystroke using the default close hotkey or command.
summary: Real Pin prevents accidental loss of pinned tabs by requiring confirmation before closing them via hotkeys or commands, and it adds tab grouping and compact tab views.
